description: This file defines the Comments class responsible for handling the serialization of comments and VML comments within the PHPSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for writing comments to XML format, managing authors, and generating VML comment representations for Excel files.

classes.name: Comments
classes.description: This class manages the serialization of comments into XML and VML formats for PHPSpreadsheet, handling comment data, authors, and visual representation in Excel files.

methods.name: writeComments
methods.description: Serializes worksheet comments into XML format, including authors and comment data.

methods.name: writeVMLComments
methods.description: Serializes worksheet comments into VML XML format for display in Excel.

methods.name: writeComment
methods.description: Helper method to serialize an individual comment into XML.

methods.name: writeVMLComment
methods.description: Helper method to serialize an individual comment into VML XML format.
